trustLadder.meaning: Provider returned metadata. Nothing about local presence or trust is implied.
License/terms evidence captured; unknown terms remain LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Expected hash/digest obtained from an authority distinct from downloaded bytes when possible.
Downloaded/staged bytes match expected integrity metadata.
Build/source provenance attestation verified where available.
Required disclosure and explicit action approval recorded.

p0ImplementationOrder: 1. Canonical RemoteSource/Fetch/Cache contracts mapped onto existing OnlineAuthorityEvidence and Marketplace evidence.
2. Official MCP Registry adapter: search/detail/versions only; no auto-run.
3. Open VSX adapter: search/detail/version/artifact/integrity metadata; existing lifecycle handles install authority.
4. OSV adapter: batch package/version vulnerability intelligence into existing Security Quality.
5. Hugging Face Hub model catalog adapter: public metadata/revision/files/license/gating; never mark catalog item installed.
6. GitHub Releases KForge update discovery: stable/prerelease channels, tag/commit/asset/checksum/signing evidence separation.
7. Remote Documentation framework: official OpenAPI → official docs repo/sitemap → same-domain official llms.txt; global search integration.
8. Harden existing GitHub read adapters with current API version, conditional requests, least privilege and rate-limit evidence.

databaseVerdict.recommendedNow: Keep existing bounded atomic .kforge stores behind a RemoteCatalogStore/RemoteCacheStore abstraction.
databaseVerdict.embeddedDbTrigger: Consider SQLite/FTS only when retained normalized catalogs become large enough to require indexed offline cross-provider queries, frequent incremental updates or high concurrency (e.g. tens/hundreds of thousands of records or cache sizes around/above 100 MB). These are engineering thresholds, not provider requirements.
databaseVerdict.cloudDb: Optional only for user-approved account/team/cross-device sync. Supabase must not become startup, local-project, Git, runtime or install-truth authority.
